title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
subtitle: Query-Key-Value Softmax Routing in Transformers
summary: Compute softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k))V attention weights across tokens.

evaluationChart.title: Token Attention Weight Distribution (Query = 'bank')
evaluationChart.description: Shows how temperature / scaling factor 1/sqrt(d_k) sharpens or flattens token attention.

advantages: O(1) path length between any two tokens regardless of sequence distance.
Fully parallelizable across all sequence positions during training.
Dynamic context-dependent weighting (unlike static Word2Vec embeddings).
limitations: O(N²) time and memory complexity with respect to sequence length N.
Requires explicit positional encodings (RoPE/sinusoidal) since attention is permutation-equivariant.
Quadratic KV-cache growth during long-context autoregressive decoding.

formulas.description: Dividing by sqrt(d_k) keeps dot-product variance at 1 so softmax gradients do not vanish.

import math
# Dot product of Q[i] and K[j] divided by sqrt(d_k)
codeTemplates.fromScratch:
import numpy as np

def attention(Q, K, V):
    d_k = Q.shape[-1]
    scores = (Q @ K.T) / np.sqrt(d_k)
    exp_s = np.exp(scores - scores.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    weights = exp_s / exp_s.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    return weights @ V, weights
